title: Ordering Coffee
description: Percakapan singkat di kedai kopi. Fokus pada angka, ukuran, dan pertanyaan sopan.
transcript:
Barista: Hi there, what can I get for you?
Customer: Could I have a large latte, please?
Barista: Sure. Would you like that hot or iced?
Customer: Iced, please. And could you make it with oat milk?
Barista: Of course. Anything else?
Customer: That's all, thanks. How much is it?
Barista: That comes to five dollars forty.
Customer: Here you go.
Barista: Thank you. It'll be ready at the end of the counter in just a moment.

subtitles.text: Hi there, what can I get for you?
subtitles.translation: Halo, ada yang bisa saya siapkan?

subtitles.text: Could I have a large latte, please?
subtitles.translation: Boleh saya pesan latte ukuran besar?

subtitles.text: Sure. Would you like that hot or iced?
subtitles.translation: Tentu. Mau yang panas atau dingin?

subtitles.text: Iced, please. And could you make it with oat milk?
subtitles.translation: Dingin. Dan boleh pakai susu oat?

subtitles.text: Of course. Anything else?
subtitles.translation: Tentu. Ada lagi?

subtitles.text: That's all, thanks. How much is it?
subtitles.translation: Itu saja, terima kasih. Berapa harganya?

subtitles.text: That comes to five dollars forty.
subtitles.translation: Totalnya lima dolar empat puluh sen.

subtitles.text: Here you go.
subtitles.translation: Ini uangnya.

subtitles.text: Thank you. It'll be ready at the end of the counter in just a moment.
subtitles.translation: Terima kasih. Pesanannya siap di ujung konter sebentar lagi.

title: Airport Announcement
description: Pengumuman bandara dengan aksen British. Latihan menangkap nomor gate dan waktu.
transcript: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. This is a boarding announcement for flight BA two forty-seven to Singapore. Boarding will begin at gate twenty-three in approximately fifteen minutes. Passengers travelling with small children or requiring assistance are invited to board first. Please have your boarding pass and passport ready for inspection. We remind passengers that the departure gate has been changed from gate nine to gate twenty-three. Thank you.

subtitles.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen.
subtitles.translation: Selamat siang, para penumpang.

subtitles.text: This is a boarding announcement for flight BA two forty-seven to Singapore.
subtitles.translation: Ini pengumuman boarding untuk penerbangan BA 247 menuju Singapura.

subtitles.text: Boarding will begin at gate twenty-three in approximately fifteen minutes.
subtitles.translation: Boarding dimulai di gate 23 sekitar 15 menit lagi.

subtitles.text: Passengers travelling with small children or requiring assistance are invited to board first.
subtitles.translation: Penumpang dengan anak kecil atau yang membutuhkan bantuan dipersilakan naik lebih dulu.

subtitles.text: Please have your boarding pass and passport ready for inspection.
subtitles.translation: Mohon siapkan boarding pass dan paspor untuk pemeriksaan.

subtitles.text: The departure gate has been changed from gate nine to gate twenty-three.
subtitles.translation: Gate keberangkatan berubah dari gate 9 ke gate 23.

title: Stand-up Meeting
description: Rapat harian tim software. Kosakata kerja dan pelaporan progres.
transcript:
Alright, let's keep this short. Priya, where are you at?
I finished the login flow yesterday and pushed it for review. Today I'm picking up the password reset. No blockers.
Great. Marcus?
I'm still debugging the payment webhook. It works locally but fails in staging, so I'm going to pair with Sam after this. That's my blocker.
Okay, Sam, can you make time this morning?
Yeah, I'll ping you after standup.
Perfect. Anything else? No? Then let's get to it.

subtitles.text: Alright, let's keep this short. Priya, where are you at?
subtitles.translation: Baik, kita buat singkat. Priya, sampai mana?

subtitles.text: I finished the login flow yesterday and pushed it for review.
subtitles.translation: Saya menyelesaikan alur login kemarin dan sudah diajukan untuk review.

subtitles.text: Today I'm picking up the password reset. No blockers.
subtitles.translation: Hari ini saya mengerjakan reset kata sandi. Tidak ada hambatan.

subtitles.text: Great. Marcus?
subtitles.translation: Bagus. Marcus?

subtitles.text: I'm still debugging the payment webhook. It works locally but fails in staging.
subtitles.translation: Saya masih men-debug webhook pembayaran. Jalan di lokal tapi gagal di staging.

subtitles.text: So I'm going to pair with Sam after this. That's my blocker.
subtitles.translation: Jadi saya akan berpasangan dengan Sam setelah ini. Itu hambatan saya.

subtitles.text: Okay, Sam, can you make time this morning? Yeah, I'll ping you after standup.
subtitles.translation: Oke Sam, ada waktu pagi ini? Ya, saya hubungi setelah standup.
